extracted.intended_audience: Applicants for NIH K01 career development awards (early-career investigators) and university grant administrators
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and required fields for completing the Research & Related Budget (Sections A–K), Budget Justification, and the PHS 398 Career Development Award Supplemental Form for an NIH K01 (career development) application, including personnel, travel, equipment, participant costs, indirect costs, and required supplemental attachments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget - Section A: Senior/Key Person
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide Senior/Key Person entries including Prefix, First/Middle/Last Name, Suffix, Project Role, Base Salary, Calendar/Academic/Summer Months, Requested Salary, Fringe Benefits, and Funds Requested ($). Include organization name, DUNS, Budget Type, Start and End Dates, and Budget Period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form lists columns for name, salary ($), months (calendar/academic/summer), requested salary, benefits, and a line 'Total Funds Requested for all Senior Key Persons in the attached file' and 'Total Senior/Key Person'. Fill all required fields for each senior/key person.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget - Section B: Other Personnel
rubrics_metrics.description: Report number and details for Other Personnel (e.g., Post Doctoral Associates, Graduate Students, Undergraduate Students, Secretarial/Clerical, Programmer), including Project Role, Calendar/Academic/Summer Months, Requested Salary ($), Fringe Benefits, and Funds Requested ($).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include 'Total Number Other Personnel' and 'Total Salary, Wages and Fringe Benefits (A+B)'. Ensure each category lists number of personnel and calculated funds requested.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget - Section C: Equipment
rubrics_metrics.description: List equipment items and dollar amount for each item exceeding the equipment reporting threshold (form header: 'List items and dollar amount for each item exceeding $'). Provide 'Equipment Item' entries and 'Total funds requested for all equipment listed in the attached file'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach additional equipment file if needed; the form shows 'Total Equipment' and supports an attached file name and mime type. If no equipment, indicate 0.00.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget - Section D: Travel
rubrics_metrics.description: Report travel funds requested, separating Domestic Travel Costs (including Canada, Mexico, and U.S. possessions) and Foreign Travel Costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide totals for travel, and support travel justification in the Budget Justification (number of trips, destinations, trip duration, included costs such as airfare/lodging/local travel).

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget - Section E: Participant/Trainee Support Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Itemize Participant/Trainee Support Costs: Tuition/Fees/Health Insurance; Stipends; Travel; Subsistence; Other; and specify Number of Participants/Trainees and Total Participant Trainee Support Costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete fields only if participant/trainee support is requested; otherwise indicate 0.00. Use this section to capture trainee-specific costs distinct from personnel salaries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget - Section F: Other Direct Costs (detailed categories)
rubrics_metrics.description: List categories and funds requested for Other Direct Costs, including Materials and Supplies; Publication Costs; Consultant Services; ADP/Computer Services; Subawards/Consortium/Contractual Costs; Equipment or Facility Rental/User Fees; Alterations and Renovations; Course Fees and Registration; Conference Calls, Airtime and Internet Data; and country-specific review and participant costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide totals for each subcategory and attach supporting documentation in the Budget Justification. The sample lists specific Uganda-related human subjects review and participant costs as items under Other Direct Costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct Costs (Section G) and Indirect Costs (Section H) calculation
rubrics_metrics.description: Calculate Total Direct Costs (Sections A thru F) and Indirect Costs using Indirect Cost Type (e.g., MTDC), Indirect Cost Rate (%), Indirect Cost Base ($), and Funds Requested ($) for indirect costs. Provide 'Total Other Direct Costs', 'Total Direct Costs (A thru F)', and 'Total Indirect Costs'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include Cognizant Federal Agency contact (agency name, POC name, phone). Ensure correct application of MTDC rules and the RFA-specific indirect cost rate (see separate rubric entry).

rubrics_metrics.name: Total Direct and Indirect Costs, Fee, and Total Costs and Fee (Sections I–K)
rubrics_metrics.description: Report 'Total Direct and Indirect Institutional Costs (G + H)', any Fee (Section J), and 'Total Costs and Fee' (Section K) as Funds Requested ($).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sum all direct and indirect costs and include any allowable fee. Ensure totals match supporting line items and the cumulative budget.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification attachment requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Attach a Budget Justification file (one file only) describing personnel effort, fringe, travel, supplies, publications, other direct costs, participant incentives, and institutional commitments. The form repeats: '(Only attach one file.)' and lists the file name and mime type.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a clear narrative justification that supports all budget line items; attach as a single PDF (mime type application/pdf) named appropriately (e.g., FINAL_BudgJust_...).

rubrics_metrics.name: Fringe Benefits: inclusion and calculation
rubrics_metrics.description: Funds for fringe benefits are included in the personnel budget request; benefits include health insurance, Social Security & Medicare taxes, workers' compensation, medical aid & industrial insurance, UWRP, state retirement, unemployment compensation, and separation leave payments. Example rates: Research faculty 26.2%, Professional Staff 33.3%.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Calculate fringe using the institution's current rates and list them in the Budget Justification. Ensure fringe amounts are consistent with personnel salaries and institutional policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Travel justification specifics
rubrics_metrics.description: Justify number and timing of international and domestic trips (example: one trip to Uganda per year in years 1 and 3, two trips per year in years 2 and 4), anticipated trip costs (airfare, lodging, internal travel), expected trip duration (~four weeks), and conference travel (one international conference per year including registration, visa fees, lodging).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide per-trip cost estimates and explain purpose (data collection, stakeholder engagement, conference presentation) in the Budget Justification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supplies and equipment purchases justification
rubrics_metrics.description: Itemize supplies and small equipment purchases (e.g., tablet computers for data visualization, computers and external monitors for PI and programmer, software licenses). Note that R programs are open-source; ArcGIS and REDCap may be available under site license.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify timing (which year items are requested), unit costs, and purpose (e.g., data visualization aim). Explain whether software licenses are needed and whether institutional site licenses cover costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication costs justification
rubrics_metrics.description: Request support for publication fees and indicate planned year(s) when fees will be incurred; the sample increases publication fees in later years as more publications are anticipated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe the anticipated number of publications by year and justify the requested publication fee amounts in the Budget Justification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other costs: communications, printing, foreign review fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Include costs for conference calls, international airtime and internet data, printing for dissemination materials, and payments required for foreign institutional review (e.g., payment to the Uganda National Council for Science and Technology and Uganda Virus Research Institute). Note: Payment of foreign IRB fees is not supported by institutional indirect fees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Itemize these costs with rationale and show how they support activities (e.g., stakeholder engagement, data collection, regulatory approvals).

rubrics_metrics.name: Participant incentives
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify participant incentives in dollar amounts and calculation (example: $ per interview × 2 interviews per participant × 30 participants).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide per-interview incentive, number of interviews per participant, number of participants, and total calculation in the Budget Justification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class and course materials / tuition and training costs
rubrics_metrics.description: List costs for coursework, application fees, and training-related travel or scholarships (example: tuition exemption program details, application fees per course, scholarship request for SISMID, and costs for books and course materials).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain how coursework/training supports the candidate's career development plan and list specific courses, units, and estimated costs by year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indirect Costs per RFA requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Per RFA-18-369, Indirect Costs are calculated at a rate of 8% of modified total direct costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply the RFA-specific indirect cost rate (here 8%) when calculating indirect costs and document calculations in the Budget Justification.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement – Vertebrate Animals Section
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether vertebrate animals are euthanized (Yes/No). If 'Yes', indicate if the method is consistent with American Veterinary Medical Association (AVMA) guidelines; if not consistent, describe method and provide scientific justification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide required details when vertebrate animals are used, including euthanasia method, AVMA compliance, and justification for deviations.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement – Program Income Section
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether program income is anticipated during the grant period (Yes/No). If 'Yes', use the provided format to reflect anticipated amounts and source(s) by budget period; if 'No', leave the section blank.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report program income amounts and sources per budget period if applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement – Human Embryonic Stem Cells Section
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether the proposed project involves human embryonic stem cells (Yes/No). If 'Yes', list registration numbers of specific cell lines from the NIH registry or check the box indicating that a registry line will be used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide registry numbers or declare intent to use a registry-listed line; comply with NIH stem cell policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement – Inventions and Patents (Renewals)
rubrics_metrics.description: State whether there are inventions and patents (Yes/No). If 'Yes', indicate whether they were previously reported (Yes/No).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide details of reported inventions/patents for renewal applications as required.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement – Change of Investigator/Institution
rubrics_metrics.description: If applicable, indicate Change of Project Director/Principal Investigator or Change of Grantee Institution and provide name of former PD/PI or former institution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete the change-of-investigator or change-of-institution fields when such changes have occurred or are being requested.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Career Development Award Supplemental Form – Required Sections and Attachments
rubrics_metrics.description: The supplemental form requires a set of sections/attachments (numbered): Introduction; Candidate Information and Goals for Career Development; Specific Aims; Research Strategy*; Progress Report Publication List (for Renewal); Training in Responsible Conduct of Research; Candidate's Plan to Provide Mentoring; Plans and Statements of Mentor and Co-Mentor(s); Letters of Support from Collaborators/Contributors/Consultants; Description of Institutional Environment; Institutional Commitment to Candidate's Research Career Development; Vertebrate Animals; Select Agent Research; Consortium/Contractual Arrangements; Resource Sharing Plan; Authentication of Key Biological and/or Chemical Resources; Appendix.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach the indicated files with clear filenames (examples provided like FINAL_SpecificAims_ModelingTB3_20180501.pdf). Ensure each section meets PHS 398 formatting/content requirements and that required mentor statements and letters of support are included.

rubrics_metrics.name: Citizenship and visa status reporting for career development awards
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate U.S. citizenship or non-citizen national (Yes/No). If not, select most appropriate non-U.S. citizen option (Permanent U.S. Resident Visa; Temporary U.S. Visa; Not Residing in the U.S.). If a temporary visa applicant expects permanent residency by award start date, check the indicated box.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete citizenship fields accurately; some awards require permanent residency — declare expectations if applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resubmission Introduction – Responding to reviewers and including deliverables
rubrics_metrics.description: For resubmissions, include an introduction that thanks reviewers, states prior priority score, summarizes retained strengths, and explains revisions made in response to reviewers' comments. Include specific deliverables for each aim and explain modifications to the research plan, validation approaches, additional data or analyses, and changes to timelines or mentorship plans.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicitly address reviewer critiques, describe how the revised application preserves strengths and incorporates requested changes (e.g., model validation detail, additional intervention modeling, stakeholder engagement outcomes), and list concrete deliverables associated with each aim.

rubrics_metrics.name: Candidate background and career development plan requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a Candidate Background narrative outlining prior training, relevant experience, publications, coursework, and rationale for choosing mentors/institution. State long-term career goals and short-term goals for the K01 award period (examples include learning geospatial modeling, constructing/validating models, learning data visualization and implementation science, refining writing/presentation skills, and applying for future R01 funding).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Demonstrate how proposed training and mentoring will enable the candidate to devote protected effort (e.g., at least 75% effort) to research and to achieve stated career milestones; show evidence of prior productivity and relevant training history.
